_comment: GENERATED by scripts/gen_pic32mx_sfr.py from the Microchip PIC32MX DFP EDC files (pack and per-part sha256 below) -- do not hand-edit. addr = KSEG1 virtual; portals CLR/SET/INV at +4/+8/+0xC; fields = [name, lsb, width]; por = power-on reset value (unimplemented and undefined bits as 0); grp = the EDC peripheral group; vectors = [vector, cname, desc]; irqs = [irq (IFS/IEC bit), cname].
